rachel-sre: Postmortem follow-up: we surfaced 4 remediation items that change SLO wording, alerts, and dashboards. Need owners, acceptance criteria, and exact dates so we can update the SLA docs and oncall dashboards.
ben-product: I can own customer-facing SLA text + comms. Proposal: keep shared-hosted p95=330ms, introduce Dedicated p95=275ms, add a batch throughput SLO for embedding endpoints (per-tenant sustained QPS limit). Will draft PR in 4 business days.
oli-oncall: I'll own runbook + failover testing. Short-term mitigation: auto-fallback to quantized model when p99 > 1s for 3m and add a manual throttle knob. Target prototype in 5 days.
mina-platform: I'll own dashboard changes. Need queries for p50/p95/p99 by model_variant and per-tenant QPS; will add an error-budget burn-rate gauge and a recurrence heatmap.
sam-telemetry: I'll add incident markers and wire a weekly regression that replays representative embedding prompts from the top tenants. Query sketch for the dashboard:
```
select
  tenant_id, model_variant,
  quantile(0.50)(latency_ms) as p50,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99,
  count() as qps
from requests
where env='prod' and request_type='embedding' and time > now() - 1h
group by tenant_id, model_variant
```
mina-platform: Alert proposal: alert when burn_rate > 1.7 for 30m OR p99 > 1s for 5m. I'll add a staged gating rule so stricter SLOs only flip after a 7-day clean window.
rachel-sre: Owners recap: SLA=ben-product, runbook=oli-oncall, dashboard=mina-platform, telemetry=sam-telemetry. Two delivery targets: SLO doc to leadership in 6 business days, full remediation sprint complete in 14 days. OK?
ben-product: 6 business days works. I'll include comms checklist: RFC snippet, customer FAQ, internal support playbook.
oli-oncall: Runbook acceptance: steps documented, staging failover test passed, pager validated. I'll schedule the staging failover and post results.
sam-telemetry: I'll attach regression job logs and a diff view to the ticket once the job runs.
mina-platform: Dashboard acceptance: panels live in Grafana, alert tests pass in staging, link added to oncall home dashboard. Will post PR for review.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-5222 created: "SLO & dashboard remediation sprint - ownerships and timelines" assigned to rachel-sre, due 2026-05-10. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-5222
rachel-sre: Adding acceptance criteria to the ticket: SLA PR merged + product signoff; runbook merged + staging test pass; grafana panels live + alert tests green; nightly regression job running. Also adding backlog item: tenant-level rate limiter or Dedicated fast-path for heavy embedding tenants.
ben-product: I'll draft the SLO wording and a short rollout plan for customers, including a 2-week opt-in window for Dedicated tiers.
oli-oncall: For short-term relief I'll add a feature-flagged proxy throttle infra can flip during spikes; documenting in runbook.
mina-platform: Timeline recap: SLO doc in 6 days, runbook prototype in 5 days, dashboards merged in 7 days, full remediation sweep in 14 days.
rachel-sre: I'll update the postmortem with owners, ticket link, and schedule a 20-min sync in 48h to check progress. If anyone has blockers, flag here. :thumbsup:
